name: varavista/autocad-mcp

items.name: Geometry and measurement
items.basis: Executed (strict pass, ezdxf backend, offline Docker): probe F1-ordinary saved and reopened line/circle/LWPOLYLINE/arc/ellipse/hatch with identical geometry; geometry_length/area returned 50, 200, 25*pi and 5*pi exactly; unknown handle refused (F1-bad-handle). MCP stdio call geometry.distance returned 5.0. First-pass COM narrative still applies to the native path.
items.scope_and_limits: Unchanged at 2. Boundary evidence is mixed: create_hatch on a CIRCLE boundary fails ('Circle' has no get_points), and every batch.draw_* call on a fresh empty drawing refuses with 'No drawing open' because `if not self._msp` tests the empty modelspace's length (probe C1-batch-empty-drawing). No hatch islands or topology. Not a false success, so no cap, but the anchor-3 bar (boundary cases without failure) is not met.

deduction.reason: Withhold 3: ordinary path proven; boundary failures (empty-drawing batch refusal, circle hatch) and no islands/topology keep it below 3.

items.name: Editing
items.basis: Executed (strict pass, ezdxf backend, offline Docker): probe F2-transforms: move/rotate/scale/mirror/array gave exact expected coordinates after save and reopen (5 array copies, 7 lines in file); F2-trim trimmed at x=7; unknown handle refused; offset/fillet/chamfer refuse honestly. MCP stdio move with a bad handle returned ok=false.
items.scope_and_limits: Unchanged at 2. Corner operations (fillet/chamfer) are unsupported on both backends that could be evidenced (COM report, ezdxf run); offset only on COM (narrative). No requirement-driven edits or identity tracking.

deduction.reason: Withhold 3: transforms and trim behave correctly, but fillet/chamfer/offset are absent on the executable backend and there is no requirement or identity layer.

items.name: Annotation and styles
items.basis: Executed (strict pass, ezdxf backend, offline Docker): probe F3-dims: linear, aligned, angular and radius dimensions plus a leader and text saved; on reopen the DIMENSION measurements were 25.4, 50, 90 and 7.5 and the rendered blocks contain '25,4', '50', '90°', 'R7,5'.
items.scope_and_limits: Raised 1 -> 2: executed ordinary annotation now has output evidence. Rendered text uses a decimal comma (the default style the backend creates), the tools return no handle for dimensions, and there is still no tolerance/fit, style creation/modification or post-edit display check.

deduction.reason: Withhold 3: tolerances/fits and style editing are not implemented; dimension handles are not returned.

items.name: Organization and exchange
items.basis: Executed (strict pass, ezdxf backend, offline Docker): probe F4-layers-blocks: layer WALLS red/frozen/locked, block TAG with ATTDEF, INSERT with ID=P-101, and layout SHEET2 all present after save and reopen; wblock wrote a file.
items.scope_and_limits: Raised 1 -> 2 and capped at 2. Reproduced false success: layout_page_setup('SHEET2', A4, portrait) returned ok=true but the saved layout stayed 420x297; layout_viewport_set_scale, layout_viewport_lock and layout_batch_plot returned ok=true with no change and no plot file (F4-page-setup-noop, F4-viewport-noop). layout_viewport_create always fails with an ezdxf signature error. COM save_as_dxf R12 not executable here.

deduction.reason: Withhold 3: capped at 2 by the reproduced ok=true no-op page setup / viewport / batch plot operations; viewport creation is broken.

items.name: Domain workflows
items.basis: Executed (strict pass, ezdxf backend, offline Docker): 232/232 repository tests pass, including equipment find, place_equipment_tag, batch_find_and_tag and phase 4/5 (electrical/validate) behaviour on ezdxf; probe E3-connectivity-bom returned 4 dangling endpoints and BOM PUMP=3 as constructed.
items.scope_and_limits: Raised 1 -> 2: ordinary headless domain paths now have output evidence. P&ID drawing itself was not probed; no mechanical views, architectural rooms/openings or takeoff with uncertainty.

deduction.reason: Withhold 3: most item areas (mechanical, architectural, uncertain takeoff) absent.

items.name: Transactions
items.basis: Executed (strict pass, ezdxf backend, offline Docker): ezdxf undo refuses honestly (C1-undo).
items.scope_and_limits: Unchanged at 1. Reproduced on ezdxf the pattern found in COM source: batch.draw_lines with one invalid item returns ok=true, creates the valid line and keeps it (no rollback). Batch on an empty drawing refuses entirely. No preview, checkpoint or conflict handling. COM batch/undo not executable here.

deduction.reason: Withhold 4: no transaction mechanism; partial batch failures are returned as ok=true.

items.name: Intent and geometry
items.basis: Executed (strict pass, ezdxf backend, offline Docker): probe C2-purge: after adding an unused layer and block, drawing_purge returned ok=true, purged=true, and both were still present after save and reopen.
items.scope_and_limits: Unchanged at 0: no intent/geometry verification exists, and the purge false success is now reproduced. COM setup_lisp not executable here.

deduction.reason: Withhold 5: no implementation of intent checks; reproduced false success.

items.name: Delivery
items.basis: Executed (strict pass, ezdxf backend, offline Docker): save then independent reopen works for every probe; MCP stdio drawing.save produced a file whose reopen contained the created CIRCLE and LINE.
items.scope_and_limits: Raised 0 -> 1: the save entry point is now executed. Still no gate, hash, readback or parity. drawing.save to 'x.dwg' returns ok=true and writes ASCII DXF under a .dwg name (C3-dwg-ext); an existing non-DXF file is overwritten without warning; an unwritable directory raises inside the backend (the server wrapper turns it into an error).

deduction.reason: Withhold 4: no delivery verification; mislabeled .dwg output reported as success.

items.name: Foreign and abnormal inputs
items.basis: Executed (strict pass, ezdxf backend, offline Docker): probe C4-open-errors: missing file and a malformed DXF are refused with clear errors and the previous document is kept; audit(fix=false) returns an issue list.
items.scope_and_limits: Raised 1 -> 2: ordinary abnormal-input refusal is evidenced. Boundary failures: audit(fix=true) always fails ('Auditor' object has no attribute 'fix_all'); drawing.units accepts LUNITS=99 with ok=true; nec_lookup returns ok=true for an unknown table; MCP create_circle with missing fields returns a KeyError text ('cy') with a misleading 'check AutoCAD' hint.

deduction.reason: Withhold 3: boundary and invalid-value cases fail or are accepted; no external-edit or unknown-unit handling.

items.name: Backend contract

items.scope_and_limits: Unchanged at 2. Postconditions still differ by backend (reproduced ok=true no-ops on ezdxf); capability flags do not mark the no-op layout operations; the committed report's coverage table is inaccurate. File IPC/COM selection not executable here.

declared_contract: A unified Python MCP server (v5.1.0, stdio) exposing 22 tool groups (drawing, entity, layer, block, annotation, P&ID, view, query, search, geometry, select/bulk, validate, export, xref, layout, electrical NEC, connection, batch, NLP, Excel export) over three backends: File IPC (JSON files plus an AutoLISP dispatcher triggered in AutoCAD LT via PostMessage), Windows COM (AutoCAD 2018+, ZWCAD, GstarCAD, BricsCAD) and headless ezdxf. Backend auto-detection with runtime switching; operations a backend does not override return 'Not supported on this backend'.
evidence_used: MCP_VALIDATION_REPORT.md (agent-written COM checklist against AutoCAD 2026, dated 2026-04-03; COM code traced unchanged except the added setup_lisp)
pytest_output.txt (committed Windows run; errored at the first test and stopped)
gh run list -R varavista/autocad-mcp: no runs; no .github directory
Strict pass: repository test suite run offline in Docker (232 passed)
Strict pass: 29 backend probes with independent ezdxf reopen, and an MCP stdio session

serious_defects.description: Reproduced: ezdxf layout_page_setup, layout_viewport_set_scale, layout_viewport_lock and layout_batch_plot return ok=true without changing the saved drawing or producing a plot.
Reproduced: ezdxf drawing_purge returns ok=true, purged=true; the unused layer and block remain after save/reopen. COM setup_lisp reports lisp_loaded=true without confirmation (source only).
Reproduced: electrical_voltage_drop with unknown gauge '999' substitutes 1.0 ohm/kft and returns ok=true with an acceptability verdict; nec_lookup returns ok=true for an unknown table.

execute_lisp is on by default and loads arbitrary AutoLISP with SECURELOAD=0; setup_lisp writes AutoCAD startup registry entries via PowerShell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass (source). Reproduced on ezdxf: saves accept any path, outside any workspace, and overwrite existing files.
serious_defects.reproduction: not executable here (execute_lisp/setup_lisp need AutoCAD); path scope reproduced

serious_defects.description: COM batch_draw_* returns ok=true when items fail, no rollback (source). Same behaviour reproduced on ezdxf batch.draw_lines (1 of 2 created, ok=true, valid item kept).
serious_defects.reproduction: not executable here (COM); ezdxf analogue reproduced

limitations: Only the headless ezdxf backend and the stdio MCP interface were executed; COM and File IPC scores rest on first-pass source reading and the committed narrative report.
The install used the README route (unpinned), giving ezdxf 1.4.5 rather than the 1.4.3 in uv.lock; the defects found do not depend on that difference (API misuse and explicit no-op code).
The native evidence is an agent-written narrative without raw outputs, and its coverage table contains claims the source contradicts.
The COM save_as_dxf R12 reading (SaveAs(path, 1) = acR12_dxf) comes from the AutoCAD enumeration, not observed output.
Auxiliary scripts (lisps/jxp_shelf_detail.lsp, batch_tag.py, check_ipc.py) are outside the MCP tool contract and were not scored.
method: strict: pinned source + committed evidence + executed headless tests and probes in an offline Docker container
